camel_example: aliyun alb CreateAcl --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key env --ResourceGroupId 'rg-atstuj3rtop0000' --Tag.1.Value product --DryRun true --ClientToken '5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B300000' --AclName 'test-acl' --method POST --force
description_en: Creates an access control list (ACL) in a specified region
description_zh: 在指定地域创建访问控制
kebab_example: aliyun alb create-acl --acl-name test-acl --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B300000 --dry-run true --resource-group-id rg-atstuj3rtop0000 --tag Value=product Key=env --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAcl

parameters.help_en: The name of the ACL. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), letters, and Chinese characters. The name must start with a letter, a Chinese character, or a digit
parameters.help_zh: ACL的名称。必须以字母、中文或数字开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格，限制长度为2~128个字符
parameters.name: acl_name

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate a value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned. No ACL is created.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会创建访问控制策略组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The tag key. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun或acs:开头，不能包含http://或https://
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the ACL
parameters.name: tag
